module_summary: filer_browser.c is the classic uLE/wLaunchELF file browser (browseFilePath/getFilePath) with its R1 file menu, L1 view/sort popup and R2 PathPad, plus the clipboard paste engine (subfunc_Paste) and a set of exported entry points the dashboard File Browser (dash_browser.c) and mmce_igr.c reuse: filerMenuEnables, filerPasteModeInto, filerPsuPasteInto, filerPsuPasteLabel, filerMountVmc/filerUnmountVmc, filerCreateFolderIcon, filerFreeSpace, filerLaunchElfFolder. The classic browser is still live: getFilePath(…, FALSE) is called from main_actions.c:738, 774 and 886 (Misc FileBrowser, text editor return), and the cnfmode variants from config_startup.c, editor_file.c and main_exploit_installer.c. Because the dashboard entry points were added later beside the classic menu code, several classic menu branches now repeat what the exported helpers do. include/filer_copy.h declares the paste diagnostics, move-manifest and game-title helpers implemented in filer_copy.c; every declaration is used.

reusable_helpers.name: filerMountVmc
reusable_helpers.what: mounts a VMC image file as vmc0:/vmc1:, unmounting an earlier one and recording the HDD party index; message on failure

reusable_helpers.name: filerUnmountVmc
reusable_helpers.what: unmounts vmcN: and clears the VMC/party index bookkeeping

reusable_helpers.name: filerCreateFolderIcon
reusable_helpers.what: writes icon.sys and icon.icn into a folder, asking before overwriting existing ones

reusable_helpers.name: filerFreeSpace
reusable_helpers.what: free bytes of the device holding a path (mc, xfrom, HDD PFS, DVR PFS)

reusable_helpers.name: filerLaunchElfFolder
reusable_helpers.what: LaunchElfDir as a browsable path: inserts '/' after the device colon and appends a trailing '/'

reusable_helpers.name: makeDeviceRootPath
reusable_helpers.what: device root of a path ('dev:' plus '/', except host:)

reusable_helpers.name: formatBrowserPathForDisplay
reusable_helpers.what: browser path to display form (massN -> usbN, hddN:/part/sub -> hddNpart:pfs:/sub, same for dvr_hdd0)

reusable_helpers.name: getCenteredListTop
reusable_helpers.what: top row index that keeps the selection centred in a scrolling list

reusable_helpers.name: formatBrowserTimestamp
reusable_helpers.what: PS2TIME to local 'time date' string in the configured clock/date format

reusable_helpers.name: probeDirectory
reusable_helpers.what: returns TRUE if genDopen succeeds on a path (directory exists/device ready)

reusable_helpers.name: waitUntilTimer
reusable_helpers.what: busy-waits until Timer() reaches a deadline

reusable_helpers.name: filerMenuEnables
reusable_helpers.what: computes which file operations are allowed for a file/path/clipboard state

findings.title: Classic R1 'Mount vmcN' branch re-implements filerMountVmc, and filerMountVmc re-implements filerUnmountVmc
findings.problem: The MOUNTVMC0/1 branch of the classic menu (1501-1550) does the same steps as filerMountVmc (2347-2395, whose comment says 'same steps as the classic menu'): unmount the old vmcN, genFixPath, makeHostPath for host/udpfs, append the name, load_vmcman, fileXioMount, record vmc_PartyIndex/Party_vmcIndex. The unmount block is written three times (1504-1512, 2355-2363, 2404-2414). Lines 1543-1544 are no-ops: that branch only runs with cnfmode==NON_CNF (else at 1293), and ext is never changed in that mode.
findings.fix: Make the classic branch call filerMountVmc(path, &files[browser_sel], ret - MOUNTVMC0, msg1, sizeof(msg1)); on failure show msg1 with ynDialog, on success set path to 'vmcN:/' and browser_cd. Replace the unmount block inside filerMountVmc with a call to filerUnmountVmc(slot). Delete lines 1543-1544.
findings.benefit: ~45 source lines removed (50-line branch becomes ~8, 9-line unmount copy becomes 1); a few hundred bytes of .text (INFERRED, both copies are live and not garbage-collected)
findings.evidence: Read filer_browser.c:1501-1550, 2347-2416 side by side. Callers of the exported pair: dash_browser.c:1239 (filerMountVmc), mmce_igr.c:278-351 (both), so the exported versions are the live shared ones. Error texts differ (classic prints 'Result=%d' via ynDialog; filerMountVmc writes a sentence into msg), which is the only behaviour change. cnfmode==NON_CNF at 1543 follows from the if(cnfmode){...} else at 1281/1293. grep tests/ for 'vmcman not registered' and 'cnfmode = NON_CNF': no matches.

findings.title: Classic R1 'New icon' branch duplicates filerCreateFolderIcon (incl. the DoneIcon goto dummy)
findings.problem: The NEWICON branch (1457-1500) does genFixPath, icon.sys exists check with overwrite prompt, make_iconsys, genFixPath again, icon.icn exists check with overwrite prompt, make_icon: the same sequence as filerCreateFolderIcon (2420-2460), which dash_browser.c:2389 uses. The classic copy also needs a goto label with a dummy strcpy 'to make goto DoneIcon legal for gcc' (1498-1499) and ignores make_iconsys/make_icon errors.
findings.fix: In the classic branch, ask for the title and the icon text with keyboard() first, then call filerCreateFolderIcon(path, title, text, msg0, sizeof(msg0)) and set browser_cd. Delete the rest of the branch and the DoneIcon label.
findings.benefit: ~35 source lines removed; small .text saving (INFERRED, both copies are compiled and reachable)
findings.evidence: Read both blocks. grep -rn filerCreateFolderIcon: definition filer_browser.c:2420, prototype launchelf.h:596, caller dash_browser.c:2389. grep tests for DoneIcon / 'Path conversion failed': no matches. Only order difference: classic asks for the icon text after writing icon.sys; asking both up front does not change the files written.

findings.title: filerPasteInto has no caller; submenu_func_Paste/submenu_func_psuPaste duplicate the exported paste entry points
findings.problem: filerPasteInto (2315) appears only in its definition and the prototype launchelf.h:589. submenu_func_Paste (2281-2288) is filerPasteModeInto (2321-2325) with the mode taken from new_pad & PAD_SQUARE, and filerPsuPasteInto (2327-2330) only forwards to submenu_func_psuPaste (2292-2306).
findings.fix: Delete filerPasteInto and its prototype. Delete submenu_func_Paste and call filerPasteModeInto(msg0, path, new_pad & PAD_SQUARE) at line 1428. Rename submenu_func_psuPaste to filerPsuPasteInto (dropping the forwarder) and drop the two forward declarations at 975-976.
findings.benefit: ~20 source lines removed; filerPasteInto's 40-byte section is already dropped by --gc-sections (MEASURED: evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-all.tsv), the wrappers are likely inlined (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep -rn filerPasteInto over src/Launchstation (src, include, tests, docs, scripts): filer_browser.c:2315 (definition), launchelf.h:589 (prototype), nothing else. filerPasteModeInto/filerPsuPasteInto callers: dash_browser.c:892, 894, 1015. submenu_func_Paste called only at filer_browser.c:1428, submenu_func_psuPaste at 1433 and 2329. tests/test_psu_extract_to_mc.py checks dash_browser.c text for filerPsuPasteInto, which the rename keeps.

findings.title: cnfmode values USBD_IRX_CNF and USBMASS_IRX_CNF are never passed to getFilePath; stale banner describes them
findings.problem: No getFilePath call uses USBD_IRX_CNF or USBMASS_IRX_CNF (callers use USBKBD_IRX_CNF, KBDMAP_FILE_CNF, CNF_PATH_CNF, LANG_CNF, FONT_CNF, LK_ELF_CNF, TEXT_CNF, ELF_FILE_CNF, SAVE_CNF, DIR_CNF, FALSE/TRUE). The comment banner at 963-971 gives examples with setting->usbd_file and setting->usbmass_file, fields that no longer exist.
findings.fix: Delete the two enum values, their entries in cnfmode_extU/cnfmode_extL, their tests at filer_browser.c:1122 and filer.c:2279, and the banner lines 963-971.
findings.benefit: ~15 source lines removed; 8 bytes of .data for the two table rows (INFERRED: 2 rows x 4 bytes in two tables)
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'USBD_IRX_CNF|USBMASS_IRX_CNF|USBKBD_IRX_CNF' over the repo: only the enum (launchelf.h:181-187), the ext tables (filer.c:168-190), the conditions filer_browser.c:1122 and filer.c:2279 and the comment banner; config_startup.c:160 passes USBKBD_IRX_CNF only. grep 'usbd_file|usbmass_file' over *.c/*.h: only the banner at filer_browser.c:964, 969. No code compares cnfmode numerically except 'cnfmode > LK_ELF_CNF' (1122), which is unaffected by removing later values. Tables are indexed by the enum, so enum and table rows must be removed together.

findings.title: Commented-out debug code and stale comments in filer_browser.c
findings.problem: submenu_func_GetSize carries a commented-out variable block (2029-2033) and a 23-line commented-out printf/fileXioGetStat attribute dump (2080-2104) with its 'Comment out this section' markers; single commented-out lines remain at 1819, 2123, 2232 and 944; 'TEST' comments at 1591-1592; and an 'End of file: filer_browser.c' banner at 2307-2311 is followed by 200 more lines of code.
findings.fix: Delete the commented-out code and the stale markers/banners.
findings.benefit: ~40 comment lines removed; no binary change
findings.evidence: Read every cited line. The lead in cond-commented-code.tsv (2081-2103) is part of this. grep tests/ for 'Comment out', 'mcTsz', 'debug display': no test asserts on these comments.

findings.title: Unconditional printf [PASTE] traces in subfunc_Paste ship in release builds
findings.problem: subfunc_Paste prints seven '[PASTE] ...' traces with plain printf, plus a trace_vmc_paste flag that exists only for two of them. The repo's DPRINTF macro is stripped in consumer builds (include/launchelf.h:164), but these printf calls are compiled into every build and run on every paste (per item when a vmc path is involved).
findings.fix: Delete the traces and trace_vmc_paste, or change them to DPRINTF so they vanish from release builds.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines removed; ~450 bytes of format strings plus 7 call sequences (~700 bytes .rodata/.text, INFERRED from the literal lengths)
findings.evidence: Read 2147-2277. grep 'define DPRINTF' include/launchelf.h:158-164 (empty in consumer builds). grep -rn '\[PASTE\]' over the repo: only these lines; no test reads them. String lengths counted by hand: 54+56+69+57+76+84+56 = 452 bytes.

findings.title: Two-way swapKeys sprintf pairs for tooltips differ only in the button glyph
findings.problem: Four tooltips are written twice, once per swapKeys value; the two strings differ only in whether the OK glyph is '\xFF0' or '\xFF1' (and the cancel/mark glyph the other way). gui_neutrino.c:497 already does the same thing with one format and swapKeys ? '1' : '0'.
findings.fix: Write each tooltip once with %c glyph arguments computed from swapKeys, as gui_neutrino.c:497 does.
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines removed; four format strings fewer in .rodata (INFERRED, ~250 bytes)
findings.evidence: Compared each pair character by character: menu() 640-649 (OK/Cancel), PathPad_menu 755-777 (Use / Clear,Set), browseFilePath 1928-1941 (OK/Cancel/Up) and 1954-1969 (OK/Up/Mark/...): only the '0'/'1' glyph digits swap. Precedent: grep 'swapKeys \?' src -> gui_neutrino.c:497. Classic upstream-derived code; other classic files likely have the same pattern (not checked, outside this unit).

findings.title: Small redundancies in filer_browser.c: mx4sio wrapper, recomputed rows, LaunchElfDir path fix, unused width term
findings.problem: markMx4sioDestinationAfterWrite (142-148, one caller at 2268) repeats the NULL and 'mx4sio' checks that discardNextMx4sioRootListing already makes through isMx4sioRootPath (filer.c:1482-1495). Lines 1741 and 1745 recompute font_height and rows exactly as 1724-1725 did with nothing changed in between. The R3 folder branch (1223-1229) re-implements filerLaunchElfFolder (2517-2528). In BrowserModePopup, the width term for LNG(Timestamp) alone (822-823) can never exceed the Timestamp+Old_to_New term at 816.
findings.fix: Call discardNextMx4sioRootListing(path) at 2268 and delete the wrapper; delete lines 1741 and 1745; replace 1223-1229 with filerLaunchElfFolder(path, sizeof(path)); delete 822-823.
findings.benefit: ~15 source lines removed; negligible binary change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: grep markMx4sioDestinationAfterWrite: definition 142 and call 2268 only. filer.c:1482-1495: isMx4sioRootPath returns FALSE for NULL and matches only mx4sio: roots. 1726-1740 only clamp browser_sel/top and clear the screen. filerLaunchElfFolder does the same '/' insertion and also adds a trailing '/', harmless for a folder path. grep tests for 'LaunchElfDir + (p - path)': none.

findings.title: hdd/dvr_hdd blocks of formatBrowserPathForDisplay are the same code twice
findings.problem: The HDD block (278-302) and the DVRP block (304-325) split 'dev:/partition/sub' into partition and subpath with identical code and print '<dev><partition>:pfs:<sub>'; they differ only in the prefix length (6 vs 10) and the device text.
findings.fix: Compute the prefix length and device text first (hddN: or dvr_hdd0:) and run one copy of the split-and-print code.
findings.evidence: Read 266-329; lines 284-301 and 307-324 are line-for-line the same apart from the offset and format prefix. DVRP is defined by ps2.yaml (brief section 2), so both blocks are compiled.

findings.title: isHddRootPath/isHddBrowserPath defined separately in four files
findings.problem: filer_browser.c and filer_copy.c both define a static isHddRootPath with the same 'hddN:/' test (filer_copy.c inlines it in one expression); filer.c defines another through getHddDeviceFromPath; filer_browser.c and elf.c each define isHddBrowserPath.
findings.fix: Keep one exported isHddBrowserPath/isHddRootPath pair (e.g. in filer_shared.h next to the other path helpers) and delete the static copies.
findings.benefit: ~10 source lines removed; no meaningful binary change (INFERRED, static copies are tiny)
findings.evidence: grep '(int|bool) (isHddBrowserPath|isHddRootPath)\(' over the repo: filer_browser.c:18,23, filer_copy.c:349, filer.c:674, elf.c:362. filer.c's version goes through getHddDeviceFromPath, so whether it accepts exactly the same units was not checked (INFERRED same intent). tests/test_listing_complete.py:240 extracts filer.c's static isHddRootPath by name, so that test needs updating with the change.
